sources.entry: PuppyOne - A local-first workspace where you and your AI work on the same files.

summary.one_liner: PuppyOne is a desktop app (macOS and Windows, also installable via npm) that opens any local folder so AI agents can edit its files, with every change tracked in Git and optional cloud hosting.
summary.what_it_does: PuppyOne opens an existing folder on your computer without import or migration and renders many formats in place, including DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF, images, audio and video, Markdown, JSON, HTML, GLB 3D models, and ZIP/TAR.GZ archives. Files remain ordinary files on disk. Git is built in: after an agent edits the folder, the sidebar shows a change list, a history timeline, and per-commit detail, with line diffs for text, a redline view for Word documents, and change summaries for binary files. Single files or the whole folder can be rolled back to an earlier version. It supports multiple agents: a built-in puppyone Agent, WorkBuddy, and CLI-based agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Cursor, and Hermes, plus other agents through puppyone Cloud and MCP. Optionally, the folder can be placed in puppyone Cloud so agents on other devices can keep working on the same files after the laptop is closed, with a separate scoped key for each agent.
use_cases: let an AI agent edit my documents safely
review and revert changes an AI made to files
view Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files in a folder
keep a folder of files available to agents when my laptop is off
compare redlines of agent-edited Word documents
use Claude Code or Cursor on a shared local folder
how_to_run: Download the installer for macOS or Windows from the README links
notable: Git tracking is built in with no configuration, including a redline view for Word documents
Opens existing folders in place; files stay on disk unless put in puppyone Cloud
Supports many agents, from a built-in agent to CLI tools like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
Per-agent keys in puppyone Cloud scoped to specific paths
Optional, user-controllable analytics with a documented event list
caveats: Cloud connection in the app is Early Access
Built-in puppyone Agent uses trial credit then pay-as-you-go, unless you bring your own API key or local model
Agent support varies by platform (for example, Cursor is listed for macOS and Linux only, Hermes for macOS and Linux)
